C1404.title: Case Study of the Compound Governance Attack
C1404.summary: In July 2024, Compound governance Proposal 289 passed by 682,191 votes to 633,636. It proposed allocating 499,000 COMP from the treasury, worth about $24 million at the time, to a goldCOMP yield strategy promoted by the Golden Boys. Community members argued that the proposers' concentrated token holdings and coordinated voting constituted a governance attack. The parties later reached an alternative arrangement, and the original transfer plan was withdrawn.
